title: Tom Scream
blurb: Eighty years of Jerry-related catastrophes, distilled into a single wail — and, famously, produced by William Hanna himself, who supplied the cat's shriek for decades because nobody else quite got it right. The vintage theatrical quality is what makes it so useful now: a stubbed toe, a jump scare or an electricity bill acquires genuine 1940s slapstick grandeur when scored with it. Nothing in modern animation screams like this any more. Play it for overreactions of every size, particularly ones where the injury was entirely self-inflicted.
origin: Tom's iconic scream from Tom and Jerry.
